description: Compare multiple fashion products side-by-side on Realry.com — shows best price, discount rate, and number of stores for each. Use Product IDs from search_products results. Ideal for "which is cheaper?" or "help me decide between these" questions.

country.description: Two-letter market code deciding shipping availability, prices and currency. Defaults to US when omitted or unrecognised. Pass the shopper's own country — prices and stock differ per market.

product_ids.description: List of 2–5 Product IDs to compare (shown as "Product ID: `xxx`" in search results)

name: compare_products
title: Compare Products
